subject: Request: GCP marketplace rebill across entities + VAT evidence needed
messages:
From: CloudMetrics Billing <billing@cloudmetrics.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: marketplace-billing@gcp.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Action requested: rebill GCP invoice (aggregate -> entity split)

Hi Aditya,

We flagged an issue during this month's GCP Marketplace settlement: the invoice for Acme Software (Sept usage) was issued to CloudMetrics as the reseller on a consolidated line and needs to be rebilled across two end-customer legal entities (Acme Software EU Ltd. and Acme Software UK Ltd.) to satisfy local VAT accounting.

What we need from you to proceed with rebilling:
- Confirm the target legal entity tax IDs (VAT number for EU entity, UK VAT/GBUID for UK).
- Provide VAT registration certificates for each entity (PDF).
- Confirm PO numbers or billing references to map usage rows.
- If you require a billing amendment (DocuSign), confirm the signatory and email.

Attached: preliminary_usage_202609.csv (sample rows with marketplace usage lines we propose to split).

If you can send the VAT certs and the entity mapping by EOD Friday (2026-10-16), we can aim to rebill in the next settlement cycle and issue any necessary credit notes. Otherwise we can apply a temporary credit hold while the rebill is processed — please indicate preference.

Thanks,
Sam Bennett
CloudMetrics Billing Ops
billing@cloudmetrics.com

---
Attachment: preliminary_usage_202609.csv (CSV, 48KB)
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Sam Bennett <billing@cloudmetrics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Action requested: rebill GCP invoice (aggregate -> entity split)

Sam — thanks for the heads up and the sample. Looping in Marissa (Finance) and Karthik (Marketplace ops).

We can supply the VAT certs and the entity mapping. Attached I'm sharing our current entity mapping and the VAT files we have on record; please confirm if the PDF formats and the specific VAT IDs below are sufficient:
- Acme Software EU Ltd. — VAT: EU123456789 (cert attached)
- Acme Software UK Ltd. — VAT/GB: GB987654321 (cert attached)

We've also attached redwood_entity_mapping_20261014.csv which maps marketplace SKUs to our internal charge codes and the PO lines. PO numbers are included where present.

On the credit hold: please put a temporary credit hold on the original consolidated invoice until rebilling confirms next steps. We prefer rebill + credit adjustment over a standalone refund. If you need a signed amendment, include the DocuSign link and I will route.

Next steps for us: Marissa will validate tax docs and confirm the signatory. Karthik, please review the mapping and estimate the work to break the lines per entity.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Thanks everyone — we can proceed. Two operational notes:

1) VAT evidence: The PDFs you provided are fine. We will attach them to the rebill records for audit.

2) DocuSign amendment: We need a signed billing amendment from Redwood authorizing the rebill and credit assignment back to Acme's end entities. Please sign here: https://www.docusign.com/signer/embedded?token=abc123-rebill-amend — signatory can be Aditya or Marissa.

We will draft the rebill and credit notes once the amendment is signed. Estimated timeline: we can submit the change to GCP Marketplace within 3 business days of receiving the signed amendment. Actual posting by Marketplace depends on their settlement cycle (typically up to 14 days).

We will also place a temporary credit hold as requested; you'll see a hold reference in your billing dashboard.

Sam Bennett
CloudMetrics Billing Ops
